entries.title: Mortal Shell
entries.definitive_edition: Mortal Shell: Digital Deluxe Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with The Virtuous Cycle and Rotten Autumn content available.

primary.version: Digital Deluxe Edition / base game plus The Virtuous Cycle
primary.why: The Windows PC Digital Deluxe route is the best main-play version because it keeps native PC capture/settings flexibility and bundles the base game with The Virtuous Cycle expansion; the free Rotten Autumn update content is also part of the modern content set. The Switch Complete Edition is convenient because it bundles all updates and DLC, and the PS5/Xbox Series Enhanced Edition adds 4K/60 console upgrades, but neither adds sourced exclusive game content over a complete PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Mortal Shell: Digital Deluxe Edition on Steam, install Mortal Shell and The Virtuous Cycle, then play the native Windows PC build with the Rotten Autumn update content present.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition is a console upgrade for PS5/Xbox Series X|S rather than a PC replacement; Switch Complete Edition is complete but not the fidelity-first pick.
